title: alectryon pubescens
intro: Alectryon pubescens, commonly known as the Koa haole or Koa hawaii, is a species of flowering plant in the family Sapindaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional Hawaiian medicine for various health benefits. The health benefits of Alectryon pubescens include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and prevent cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties.
